newsitem.title: DENMARK: Bullish Danish shares race on to new record highs.
newsitem.headline: Bullish Danish shares race on to new record highs.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Wednesday, with the top-20 KFX index hitting a new record closing high and dealers seeing more gains ahead if the dollar, bonds and Dow Jones remain stable.
"There's no sign of any profit-taking ahead, so if the United States holds its own overnight there is no reason why we should not see more gains tomorrow," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 0.79 point to finish at a new record closing level of 124.46 in overall bourse turnover of 1.451 billion crowns. The KFX December future remained untraded at 124.25.
Copenhagen Airports was one of the key shares of the day, charging 24 crowns ahead to end at 607 in 90,000 volume.

Denials by Radiometer management of newspaper reports of a major imminent overseas acquisition, left the medical instrument manufacturer paper only nine crowns higher at the end of the day 383, after hitting 396 in early trading.
